facts.text: Maria took a solo trip that was described as transformative and helped her grow.

evidence.quote: I realized that it's important to value different perspectives and the power of solitude.
It sounds like your solo trip was a transformative experience.

facts.text: Maria tried surfing for the first time during her trip and found it exciting despite falling off repeatedly.

evidence.quote: I tried my hand at surfing for the first time- it was so exciting! Even though I kept falling off, it taught me the power of not giving up and trying new things.

facts.text: Maria's trip included a moment of reflection on the importance of letting go and trusting life.

evidence.quote: it reminded me of the importance of letting go and trusting life sometimes.
